summary: Supply-chain hardening: bundled deploys + locked dependency versioning
description: Harden against supply-chain attack surfaces. Scope agreed 2026-07-10: (1) CI builds the release artifact (source + node_modules + .next) and ships it to the VPS over the existing tailnet SSH hop — the VPS stops running git clone + npm ci + next build entirely; (2) versioning lockdown — exact pins in package.json, .npmrc save-exact, npm audit signatures gate in CI, SHA-pin the floating actions in ci.yml. Explicitly out of scope: pinning/self-hosting Clerk's clerk-js (user decision — newest releases carry bug fixes, lose-lose) and the CSP capstone which depended on it. Migration note: deploy.sh self-updates from the fetched release, so the first deploy after this change still runs the old clone-based script, which re-execs the new tarball-aware one.

resolution.note: All four children closed. Scope shipped: exact pins + save-exact + engines, SHA-pinned actions + npm audit signatures in both workflows, CI-built release tarball shipped over tailnet, VPS deploy.sh with zero GitHub/npm egress. Clerk pinning deliberately excluded (user decision).
